• Responsable opérationnel : Agir en tant que principal point de contact mondial et centre de coordination pour le programme Cadence, en alignant les intervenants interfonctionnels sur les activités de merchandising, les activités commerciales et la planification afin d'assurer l'exécution en temps opportun.

• Vous possédez des compétences avancées dans les systèmes de planification et une compréhension profonde des modèles de reconstitution continue (NOS, VMI) et l'optimisation des stocks.

• Vous avez la capacité éprouvée de construire de nouveaux processus nets à partir de zéro, transformant les réalités complexes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en procédures d'exploitation standard (SOP) robustes et répétables.

• Vous synthétisez expertement les gens et les intérêts, gérant efficacement les attentes et tenant des frontières avec les cadres supérieurs des équipes commerciales, opérationnelles et techniques.

• Vous êtes à l'aise d'opérer de manière autonome pour fixer des priorités, briser la complexité pour aligner et amener les autres à bord dans un environnement en croissance rapide.

• L'expérience préalable des programmes de réceptivité est un plus.

• Capacité de définir et de structurer des initiatives, d'élaborer des feuilles de route, de suivre les progrès et de mettre en évidence les risques.

• Forte capacité de communication écrite et verbale.

• Confort dans la pensée stratégique et la capacité à explorer les détails opérationnels.

L'équipe de planification intégrée de bout en bout est l'orchestreur de croissance d'On. Nous nous associons à l'ensemble de l'entreprise pour orchestrer des activités de planification de bout en bout - la planification de la demande, la planification de l'offre, l'IBP et l'analyse tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Combinant les données financières avec les données sur les produits, les données commerciales et les données sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement, nous fournissons une visibilité et des analyses pour la prise de décision afin d'alimenter la croissance évolutive à On. Nous livrons l'innovation dans notre façon de travailler et l'excellence dans tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous agissons comme le pont entre les équipes de planification d'On-S - recueillir et comprendre toutes les perspectives, orchestrer la voie critique et s'assurer que la reddition de comptes et l'exactitude sont au premier plan de la façon dont nous planifions. jobs.description:

 At On, our Material Design team is central to defining the intersection of performance, aesthetics, and sustainability. We are looking for a Lead - Material Designer to join us here at On. In this role you will be responsible for setting the material design vision, driving innovation, and ensuring excellence across product categories.

Materials are a key expression of our brand—shaping how products perform, feel, and connect emotionally with consumers. As a Lead Material Designer, you combine deep technical expertise with a strong creative point of view to guide the development of material strategies and narratives at a global level.
You lead and inspire teams, influence product direction, and translate cultural, technological, and sustainability insights into forward-thinking material solutions that define On’s future.

Your mission
 - Material Strategy Leadership – Define and drive the long-term material design vision across categories, aligning with brand, product strategy, and business goals
- Seasonal Direction Setting – Own and lead seasonal material briefs, ensuring clarity, innovation, and alignment with commercial, sustainability, and margin targets
- Creative Direction & Storytelling – Establish strong, differentiated material narratives that elevate product storytelling and reinforce brand identity
- Material Innovation – Lead the exploration and integration of new materials, technologies, and finishes, pushing boundaries in performance and sustainability
- Material Development Oversight – Guide and challenge the development of engineered materials and constructions, ensuring design intent is realized at the highest level
- Materialways & Feasibility Leadership – Ensure material proposals are both visionary and executable, grounded in manufacturing expertise and scalability
- Material Systems & Efficiency – Oversee material mapping and library strategy to drive consistency, efficiency, and scalability across product lines
- Cross-Functional Leadership – Act as a key partner and decision-maker across Footwear Design, Color, Development, and Product Strategy teams
- Color & Material Integration – Lead the integration of color and material strategies from concept through execution
- Stakeholder Influence – Present and communicate material strategies and concepts at a senior level, driving alignment and key decisions
- Team Leadership & Mentorship – Lead, mentor, and develop Material Designers, fostering growth, creativity, and high performance within the team
- Culture & Innovation Driver – Champion a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team and across functions

jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. jobs.description:
At a Glance

You are the Senior Director of Apparel Marketing , reporting directly into the CMO. Your mission is to be the direct brand partner to the Creative Director of apparel, inspire teams across On, champion our culture, and be recognized as a guardian of the Apparel brand portfolio and strategic direction, ensuring all Marketing efforts in Apparel align with the main On priorities, influenced by the external global landscape.

• Work Focus: You will define and lead the function-wide brand strategy for Apparel, overseeing multiple complex and strategic initiatives with a core focus on Apparel. This role demands enterprise-level strategic expertise and has a critical, systemic impact throughout On.

• Decision-making: You are experienced at driving high-level decisions, acting as the decision maker for the Apparel Brand Management function and playing a key role in executive decision-making.

• Scope: Projects and initiatives under your direction have a strategic impact on On’s entire portfolio and long-term direction. You collaborate with the C-suite, senior leadership and are a key stakeholder to the Management Team.

• Autonomy: You own the Apparel Brand Management discipline globally, defining operating models and priorities. You are responsible for simplifying complex organizational situations and prioritizing critical work across the enterprise. You play a key role in ensuring synergies across all product categories, marketing channels, and regions.

Your Mission

Your core mission is to elevate the global On brand by architecting the structure, defining the strategy, and leading the talent required to execute our brand promise across all categories.

Set the Enterprise Brand Vision & Governance

• Define the long-term, multi-year architecture for the Apparel Brand Management function, dictating how all category brand leads (including the Head of Brand, Apparel) approach their business to ensure a unified global brand identity.

• Align and secure buy-in from the C-suite and all regional Managing Directors on the overarching brand strategy and resource allocation across major product verticals.

• Simplify and prioritize the complex portfolio of brand initiatives to focus resources on the highest-value opportunities for On’s sustainable growth.

Drive Organizational and Talent Excellence

• Serve as the senior organizational leader who coaches, mentors, and directs the Apparel Brand team to raise the bar on strategic thinking and execution quality. You will also influence and drive

• Architect the global operating model for Apparel Brand management, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making rights between product, marketing, and commercial teams globally.

• Act as the primary interface between the Apparel Brand function and Executive Leadership, communicating the brand strategy, performance, and talent needs.

Measure for Systemic Evolution

• Establish and mandate the key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics (e.g., brand health, cultural relevance, portfolio value) used across all apparel categories and regions to measure brand success.

• Drive a culture of measurement that informs strategic shifts in product investment, market entry, and commercial priorities at the executive level.

Your Story

You are a recognized executive leader with a track record of driving change and growth at a global scale. You possess the intellectual curiosity and gravitas necessary to challenge the status quo at the highest levels of the organization while fostering a culture of high performance and psychological safety within your team.

You see yourself as an enterprise-level strategist, capable of navigating ambiguity and complexity to deliver simple, high-impact organizational solutions. You are a Culture and Talent Catalyst who inspires senior leaders and develops the next generation of leadership.

We’d love to hear from people with:

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global brand management, brand strategy, or equivalent roles within premium sportswear, fashion, or consumer industries.

• A minimum of 8+ years in a senior managerial role , managing a team of Director-level or equivalent leaders and overseeing a complex, multi-category brand portfolio.

• Demonstrated ability to architect long-term strategic plans (5-year horizon) and successfully align C-suite, regional presidents, and cross-functional SVP/EVP leadership teams.

• Executive-level presence and exceptional presentation skills; comfortable presenting strategy, performance, and organizational recommendations in front of large internal and external audiences.

• A high level of intellectual curiosity and a strategic mind balanced with the ability to define simple, executable frameworks for global teams.

What We Offer

• A challenging role that puts you at the forefront of On's global expansion and brand architecture, offering unparalleled influence on the company's long-term success.

• A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles, and challenges.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Svolgete un ruolo chiave nel garantire sinergie in tutte le categorie di prodotti, canali di marketing e regioni.

- Definire l'architettura pluriennale e pluriennale per la funzione Brand Management di Brand Barley, dettando come tutte le categorie di brand lead (compreso il Head of Brand, Barrel) si avvicinino al proprio business per garantire un'identità globale unificata del brand. - Allineare e garantire il buy-in dalla C-suite e da tutti i Direttori di Gestione regionali sulla strategia generale del marchio e sull'allocazione delle risorse attraverso le principali verticali dei prodotti. - Semplificare e dare priorità al complesso portafoglio di iniziative di brand per focalizzare le risorse sulle opportunità più importanti per la crescita sostenibile di On.s.

Guidare l'eccellenza organizzativa e di ingombro

- Serve come senior leader organizzativo che allena, guida e dirige il team di Brand di Rarel per alzare il livello di pensiero strategico e qualità dell'esecuzione. Influirà e guiderà anche - Architetti il modello operativo globale per la gestione del Brand Rarel, garantendo ruoli chiari, responsabilità e diritti decisionali tra team di prodotto, marketing e commerciali a livello globale. - Agire come interfaccia primaria tra la funzione Brand Rarel e la leadership esecutiva, comunicando la strategia del marchio, le prestazioni e le esigenze di talento.

Misura per l'evoluzione sistemica

- Stabilire e affidare i principali indicatori di performance (KPI) e metriche (ad esempio, salute del marchio, rilevanza culturale, valore di portafoglio) utilizzati in tutte le categorie di abbigliamento e regioni per misurare il successo del marchio. - Guidare una cultura di misurazione che informi i cambiamenti strategici negli investimenti di prodotto, l'ingresso sul mercato e le priorità commerciali a livello esecutivo.

La tua storia

Siete un leader esecutivo riconosciuto con un record di guida di cambiamento e crescita a livello globale. Si dispone della curiosità intellettuale e gravitas necessari per sfidare lo status quo ai più alti livelli dell'organizzazione, promuovendo una cultura di alte prestazioni e sicurezza psicologica all'interno del vostro team.

Vi vedete come uno stratega di livello enterprise, capace di navigare in ambiguità e complessità per fornire soluzioni organizzative semplici e ad alto impatto. Siete una Cultura e Catalyst che ispira leader senior e sviluppa la prossima generazione di leadership.

Requisiti

- 15+ anni di esperienza di leadership progressista nella gestione globale del marchio, strategia del marchio o ruoli equivalenti all'interno di un'industria sportiva premium, della moda o dei consumatori. - Un minimo di 8+ anni di ruolo manageriale senior, la gestione di un team di Director-leader o di leader equivalenti e la supervisione di un complesso, multi-categoria di brand portafoglio. - Capacità dimostrativa di progettare piani strategici a lungo termine (5 anni di orizzonte) e allineare con successo C-suite, presidenti regionali, e cross-funzionale SVP/EVP team di leadership.

- presenza a livello esecutivo e capacità di presentazione eccezionali; confortevole presentazione di strategie, performance e raccomandazioni organizzative di fronte a grandi pubblico interno ed esterno. - Un alto livello di curiosità intellettuale e una mente strategica equilibrata con la capacità di definire quadri semplici ed eseguibili per team globali.

Cosa offriamo

- Un ruolo impegnativo che ti pone in prima linea nell'espansione globale e nell'architettura del marchio di On, offrendo un'influenza senza precedenti sul successo a lungo termine dell'azienda. - Un processo di reclutamento interno equo ed equilibrato con l'opportunità di conoscere altri team, ruoli e sfide.

E' un datore di lavoro per pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, al progresso e al mantenimento sono esenti da discriminazioni.

Markengesundheit, kulturelle Relevanz, Portfoliowert), die in allen Bekleidungskategorien und -regionen zur Messung des Markenerfolgs verwendet werden. - Förderung einer Messkultur, die strategische Veränderungen in Produktinvestitionen, Markteintritt und kommerziellen Prioritäten auf der Führungsebene informiert.

Sie sind ein anerkannter Führungspersönlichkeitsführer mit einer Erfolgsbilanz des Wachstums und der Veränderung im globalen Maßstab. Votre mission

Définir la vision de marque d'entreprise et la gouvernance

jobs.description:
In short
 As the Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, you will shape and drive the Global Merchandising strategy across On’s Lifestyle portfolio, spanning both Lifestyle Footwear and Special Projects across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.
You will own the global range architecture, consumer proposition and tailored assortments, ensuring On delivers the right product, to the right consumer, in the right channel, at the right time and at the right price.
At the heart of this role is creating consumer desirability and brand heat while building a sustainable and scalable Lifestyle business. You will translate On’s global brand and product strategy into compelling assortments that balance commercial performance with premium brand positioning.
You will bring a strong point of view on consumer, product, channel and market opportunity, influencing product briefs and franchise strategies from the earliest stages of development through to seasonal execution and sell-through.
For Special Projects, you will apply the same commercial and consumer lens to build high-impact, culturally relevant and strategically important product stories, using controlled distribution, scarcity and tailored assortments to create demand and strengthen On’s premium positioning.
You will partner closely with Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Regional Merchandising, Partnership Management, VM and Global and Regional Sales to ensure consumer and market insights translate into differentiated product strategies, global range architecture and commercially successful assortments.

Your mission
 Build the Global Lifestyle Merchandising Strategy
- Define and evolve the global merchandising strategy for Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating On’s broader brand and product priorities into clear consumer and commercial strategies.
- Build the global range architecture ensuring an efficient yet compelling Lifestyle proposition.
- Identify opportunities to expand Lifestyle into new consumer segments, channels and categories while protecting On’s premium positioning.
- Develop clear merchandising frameworks that balance consumer desirability, brand heat, commercial opportunity and sustainable profitability.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influence product briefs and franchise strategies from concept through to commercialization, ensuring products are rooted in clear consumer and market opportunities.
- Establish clear roles for hero, core, growth and incubation franchises, ensuring the portfolio evolves with consumer demand.
- Identify when franchises should be scaled, reset, repositioned or exited based on consumer and commercial signals.

Own Global Range & Assortment Excellence
- Build seasonal range plans across Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating global strategy into detailed SKU-level line plans.
- Build consumer-right tailored channel assortments globally, balancing global consistency with regional and account-specific opportunities.
- Provide a clear point of view on product flow, colour needs, depth, price and channel distribution to maximize seasonal performance.
- Ensure global and regional teams are aligned on the range strategy while allowing appropriate market localization.

Lead Special Projects
- Own the global merchandising strategy for Special Projects, working project-by-project to define the consumer proposition, range, targets, distribution and commercial strategy.
- Develop clear scarcity and allocation frameworks to balance brand heat with commercial opportunity.
- Partner closely with Product, Design and Brand to bring strategically important innovations and collaborations to market.
- Ensure Special Projects acts as an incubator for future Lifestyle franchises, consumer insights and new business opportunities.
- Set sell-through, volume, NS and productivity targets and ensure the range is structured to deliver against them.

Drive Commercial Performance
- Own global seasonal targets and commercial KPIs across Lifestyle and Special Projects.
- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional actions to address them.
- Use performance data, consumer signals and market intelligence to continuously refine the global range strategy.

Your story
 - 8+ years of experience within premium sportswear, luxury fashion or streetwear with significant experience owning global or multi-market businesses.
- Strong people leader with the ability to build, develop and inspire a high-performing global merchandising team.
- Proven track record of building global merchandising strategies and commercial plans across multiple channels and markets.
- Deep understanding of Lifestyle and sneaker culture, with a strong instinct for what will create consumer relevance and brand heat.
- Commercially strong, with the ability to balance brand aspiration, consumer desirability and financial performance.
- Highly comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between 5-year vision and SKU-level detail.
- Exceptional relationship builder who can connect Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Merchandising, Sales and Regional teams around a common consumer and commercial ambition.
- A resilient, entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, embraces change and proactively builds solutions in a high-growth environment.
- Data-led but consumer obsessed, able to combine quantitative insights with strong product and cultural intuition.

Meet the team
 On’s Global Merchandising Team sits at the center of Product, Brand and Commercial Strategy, ensuring we create and deliver the right product to the right consumer, in the right market, at the right time and at the right scale.
As the Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, you will lead the merchandising strategy for one of On’s key future growth opportunities, working across global and regional teams to build a consumer-led, commercially sustainable and culturally relevant Lifestyle business.
You will be a key voice in shaping not only what we sell, but where On plays, how we build demand and how we scale the Lifestyle business globally

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

In breve
In qualità di Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, formerai e guiderai la strategia Global Merchandising attraverso il portafoglio On’s Lifestyle, che spazia sia Lifestyle Footwear che Special Projects attraverso Footwear, Apparel e Accessories.
Avrete la gamma globale architettura, proposizione dei consumatori e assortiti su misura, assicurando On consegna il prodotto giusto, al consumatore giusto, nel canale giusto, al momento giusto e al prezzo giusto.
Al centro di questo ruolo è la creazione di desirability dei consumatori e calore del marchio, mentre la costruzione di un business Lifestyle sostenibile e scalabile. Tradurrete la strategia globale del marchio e del prodotto di On in assortimento convincenti che bilanciano le prestazioni commerciali con il posizionamento premium del marchio.
Si porterà un forte punto di vista sul consumatore, sul prodotto, sul canale e sulle opportunità di mercato, influenzando i brief dei prodotti e le strategie di franchising dalle prime fasi di sviluppo fino all'esecuzione stagionale e alla vendita-attraversamento.
Per i Progetti Speciali, si applica la stessa lente commerciale e di consumo per costruire storie di prodotti di alto impatto, culturalmente rilevanti e strategicamente importanti, utilizzando distribuzione controllata, scarsità e assortimento su misura per creare domanda e rafforzare il posizionamento premium On.
Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con Prodotto, Design, Innovazione, Brand, Merchandising Regionale, Partnership Management, VM e vendite globali e regionali per garantire che le intuizioni dei consumatori e del mercato traducono in strategie di prodotto differenziate, architettura a gamma globale e assortimento di successo commerciale.

La tua missione
Costruisci la strategia di commercializzazione Global Lifestyle
- Definire ed evolvere la strategia di merchandising globale per Lifestyle e Progetti Speciali, traducendo le priorità del marchio e del prodotto di On in chiare strategie di consumo e commerciali.
- Costruisci l'architettura globale della gamma garantendo una proposta di Lifestyle efficiente e convincente.
- Identificare le opportunità di espandere lo stile di vita in nuovi segmenti di consumo, canali e categorie proteggendo il posizionamento premium di On.
- Sviluppare chiare strutture di merchandising che bilanciano la desirability del consumatore, il calore del marchio, l'opportunità commerciale e la redditività sostenibile.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influenza i brief dei prodotti e le strategie di franchising dal concept alla commercializzazione, assicurando che i prodotti siano radicati in chiare opportunità di consumo e di mercato.
- Stabilire ruoli chiari per eroi, core, crescita e incubazione franchising, assicurando che il portafoglio si evolve con la domanda dei consumatori.
- Identificare quando i franchising devono essere scalati, reimpostati, riposizionati o usciti in base a segnali di consumo e commerciali.

Eccellenza Global Range & Assortimento
- Costruire piani di gamma stagionali su Lifestyle e Progetti Speciali, traducendo la strategia globale in piani di linea a livello di SKU dettagliati.
- Costruire Assortimenti di canali su misura di diritto dei consumatori a livello globale, bilanciando la coerenza globale con opportunità regionali e specifiche per account.
- Fornire un punto di vista chiaro sul flusso del prodotto, le esigenze di colore, la profondità, il prezzo e la distribuzione dei canali per massimizzare le prestazioni stagionali.
- Assicurarsi che i team globali e regionali siano allineati sulla strategia di gamma, consentendo al contempo una localizzazione di mercato appropriata.

Progetti speciali di piombo
- Proprio la strategia globale di merchandising per i Progetti Speciali, il progetto-progetto di lavoro per definire la proposta di consumo, la gamma, gli obiettivi, la distribuzione e la strategia commerciale.
- Sviluppare chiare strutture di scarsità e allocazione per bilanciare il calore del marchio con opportunità commerciali.
- Collabora a stretto contatto con Prodotto, Design e Brand per portare sul mercato innovazioni e collaborazioni strategicamente importanti.
- Assicurare che i Progetti Speciali siano un incubatore per future franchising Lifestyle, intuizioni dei consumatori e nuove opportunità di business.
- Imposta gli obiettivi di vendita, volume, NS e produttività e assicura che la gamma sia strutturata per fornire contro di loro.

Prestazioni commerciali
- Proprio obiettivi stagionali globali e KPI commerciali attraverso Lifestyle e Progetti Speciali.
- Identificare i rischi commerciali e le opportunità presto e guidare azioni interfunzionali per affrontarli.
- Utilizzare i dati sulle prestazioni, i segnali dei consumatori e l'intelligenza di mercato per perfezionare continuamente la strategia globale di gamma.

La tua storia
- 8+ anni di esperienza all'interno di abbigliamento sportivo premium, moda di lusso o streetwear con esperienza significativa che possiede aziende globali o multi-mercato.
- Persone forti leader con la capacità di costruire, sviluppare e ispirare un team di merchandising globale ad alto rendimento.
- Provato record di traccia di costruzione di strategie di merchandising globali e piani commerciali su più canali e mercati.
- Profonda comprensione della cultura dello stile di vita e delle sneaker, con un forte istinto per ciò che creerà rilevanza dei consumatori e calore del marchio.
- Commercialmente forte, con la capacità di bilanciare l'aspirazione del marchio, la disabilità dei consumatori e le prestazioni finanziarie.
- Funzionamento estremamente confortevole in un ambiente globale a matrice rapida, con una forte presenza esecutiva e la capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior.
- Un pensatore strategico che può muoversi senza soluzione di continuità tra visione di 5 anni e dettaglio a livello di SKU.
- Eccezionale costruttore di relazioni che può collegare i team di Prodotto, Design, Innovazione, Brand, Merchandising, Vendite e Regionali in una comune ambizione di consumo e commerciale.
- Un leader imprenditoriale resiliente che prospera in ambiguità, abbraccia il cambiamento e costruisce proattivamente soluzioni in un ambiente ad alta crescita.
- Data-led ma il consumatore ossessionato, in grado di combinare intuizioni quantitative con forte prodotto e intuizione culturale.

Incontra la squadra
Il Global Merchandising Team si trova al centro di Product, Brand e Commercial Strategy, assicurandoci di creare e consegnare il prodotto giusto al consumatore giusto, nel mercato giusto, al momento giusto e alla giusta scala.
Come Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, guiderai la strategia di merchandising per una delle principali opportunità di crescita future di On, lavorando in team globali e regionali per costruire un business Lifestyle orientato al consumatore, commercialmente sostenibile e culturalmente rilevante.
Sarete una voce chiave nel plasmare non solo ciò che vendiamo, ma dove giochiamo, come costruiamo la domanda e come scaleremo il business di Lifestyle a livello globale

Cosa offriamo
Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico – per rimanere attivi, per imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Performance Apparel

Do you have spare time alongside your studies, work, or other commitments and would like to contribute to the development of premium performance apparel?

We're looking for flexible individuals with active lifestyles to join our apparel team as Fit Models. In this role, you'll play an important part in the development and refinement of our products by participating in garment fittings throughout the product creation process.

As a Fit Model, you'll work closely with our Apparel teams, helping us ensure that our products meet the highest standards of fit, comfort, and performance. You will gain exclusive insights into upcoming products and innovations before they reach the market, becoming a trusted partner in an ongoing relationship that could extend over several seasons and years.

Because On creates performance-driven running and training gear, we are looking for people who are active, fit, and comfortable testing garments during activities such as walking or running on a treadmill.

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you, or someone you know, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Participate in apparel fitting sessions with our product teams

• Provide feedback on fit, comfort, and functionality

• Test garments during movement-based activities, including treadmill running

• Contribute to the development and refinement of future On products

• Support product teams throughout multiple stages of the design and development process

What We're Looking For

As our products are developed and tested in specific sample sizes, it's important that applicants closely match our measurement requirements and maintain measurements that remain consistent over time.

You should:

• Be based in the Zurich region and able to attend fittings in person

• Be flexible regarding appointment scheduling and session duration

• Be available to attend fitting sessions on at least two weekdays per week, as needed

• Maintain a consistent figure that aligns with our fit model requirements

• Be comfortable participating in movement-based testing activities

How to Apply

Please submit your measurements according to the instructions provided in the application form. Use a tape measure and record all measurements in centimetres.

Application Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYxhY8kQxlua6qW0MCpxhyG2eNTbRwW9Ut5_6LfVnEGlseyA/viewform?usp=publish-editor

As a Fit Model, you may be exposed to confidential products and developments. We therefore place great value on professionalism, discretion, and trust.

Please note that due to the specific measurement requirements of this role, only applicants who meet the fit model criteria will be contacted.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

In questo ruolo, potrai svolgere un ruolo importante nello sviluppo e nella raffinatezza dei nostri prodotti partecipando a raccordi di abbigliamento durante tutto il processo di creazione del prodotto.

Come Fit Model, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i nostri team Apparel, aiutandoci a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino i più elevati standard di vestibilità, comfort e prestazioni. Potrai ottenere informazioni esclusive sui prossimi prodotti e innovazioni prima di raggiungere il mercato, diventando un partner affidabile in un rapporto continuo che potrebbe estendersi in diverse stagioni e anni.

Perché? Su crea prestazioni-driven corsa e allenamento marcia, stiamo cercando persone che sono attivi, vestibilità e capi di prova confortevoli durante attività come camminare o correre su un tapis roulant.

Se questo sembra un'opportunità emozionante per te, o qualcuno che conosci, ci piacerebbe sentire da te.

Cosa farai

• Partecipa a sessioni di montaggio per abbigliamento con i nostri team di prodotti

• Fornisci feedback su misura, comfort e funzionalità

• Test di indumenti durante le attività di movimento-based, tra cui corsa tapis roulant

• Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla raffinatezza del futuro

• Supporta i team di prodotti in più fasi del processo di progettazione e sviluppo

Cosa stiamo cercando

Poiché i nostri prodotti sono sviluppati e testati in specifiche dimensioni del campione, è importante che i candidati corrispondano strettamente ai nostri requisiti di misura e mantengano misurazioni che rimangono coerenti nel tempo.

Dovresti:

• Con sede nella regione di Zurigo e in grado di frequentare gli accessori di persona

• Sii flessibile per quanto riguarda la pianificazione degli appuntamenti e la durata della sessione

• Essere a disposizione per partecipare a sessioni di montaggio su almeno due giorni settimanali a settimana, secondo le necessità

• Mantenere una figura coerente che si allinea con i nostri requisiti di modello fit

• Sii comodo partecipando alle attività di test basate sui movimenti

Come Applicare

Si prega di inviare le misure in base alle istruzioni fornite nel modulo di richiesta. Utilizzare una misura del nastro e registrare tutte le misure in centimetri.

Modulo di domanda: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYxhY8kQxlua6qW0MCpxhyG2eNTbRwW9Ut5 6LfVnEGlseyA/viewform?usp=publish-editor

Informazioni aggiuntive

Come modello Fit, potresti essere esposto a prodotti e sviluppi riservati. Si pone quindi grande valore sulla professionalità, la discrezione e la fiducia.

Si prega di notare che a causa dei requisiti di misura specifici di questo ruolo, solo i candidati che soddisfano i criteri del modello di misura saranno contattati.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

Sie erhalten exklusive Einblicke in kommende Produkte und Innovationen, bevor sie den Markt erreichen, und werden ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner in einer laufenden Beziehung, die sich über mehrere Jahreszeiten und Jahre erstrecken kann.

Weil Auf schafft leistungsorientierte Lauf- und Trainingsausrüstung, suchen wir Menschen, die aktiv sind, fit und bequem Testkleidung während Aktivitäten wie Laufen oder Laufen auf einem Laufband.

Wenn das nach einer aufregenden Gelegenheit für Sie oder jemanden klingt, den Sie kennen, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören.

Was du tun wirst

• Nehmen Sie an Bekleidungssitzungen mit unseren Produktteams teil

• Feedback zu Passform, Komfort und Funktionalität geben

• Testkleidung bei bewegungsbasierten Aktivitäten, einschließlich Laufbandlauf

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Verfeinerung zukünftiger On-Produkte

• Unterstützung von Produktteams in mehreren Phasen des Design- und Entwicklungsprozesses

Was wir suchen

Da unsere Produkte in bestimmten Probengrößen entwickelt und getestet werden, ist es wichtig, dass die Bewerber unsere Messanforderungen genau erfüllen und Messungen beibehalten, die im Laufe der Zeit konsistent bleiben.

Sie sollten:

• In der Region Zürich ansässig sein und persönlich an der Ausstattung teilnehmen können

• Seien Sie flexibel bezüglich Terminplanung und Sitzungsdauer

• An mindestens zwei Wochentagen pro Woche bei Bedarf für die Teilnahme an den passenden Sitzungen zur Verfügung stehen

• Behalten Sie eine konsistente Zahl, die mit unseren Fit-Modell-Anforderungen übereinstimmt

• Beteiligen Sie sich an bewegungsbasierten Testaktivitäten

Wie man anwendet

Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Messungen gemäß den Anweisungen im Antragsformular ein. Verwenden Sie ein Maßband und notieren Sie alle Messungen in Zentimetern.

Antragsformular: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYxhY8kQxlua6qW0MCpxhyG2eNTbRwW9Ut5 6LfVnEGlseyA/viewform?usp=publish-editor

Zusätzliche Informationen

Als Fit Model können Sie vertraulichen Produkten und Entwicklungen ausgesetzt sein. Daher legen wir großen Wert auf Professionalität, Diskretion und Vertrauen.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass aufgrund der spezifischen Messanforderungen dieser Rolle nur Bewerber kontaktiert werden, die die Kriterien des passenden Modells erfüllen.

Was wir anbieten

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz verbindet eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.

Aide à façonner l'avenir de l'Apparel de performance

Avez-vous du temps libre en plus de vos études, de vos travaux ou d'autres engagements et souhaitez-vous contribuer au développement de vêtements haut de gamme?

Nous recherchons des personnes flexibles et actives pour rejoindre notre équipe de vêtements en tant que modèles d'ajustement. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle important dans le développement et le raffinement de nos produits en participant à des accessoires de vêtements tout au long du processus de création de produits.

Ce que vous ferez

- Participer aux séances de montage de vêtements avec nos équipes de produits - Donner des commentaires sur l'ajustement, le confort et la fonctionnalité - Tester les vêtements pendant les activités axées sur les mouvements, y compris la course de tapis roulants - Contribuer au développement et au raffinement des produits futurs - Soutenir les équipes de produits tout au long des étapes multiples du processus de conception et de développement

Ce que nous cherchons

Comme nos produits sont développés et testés en tailles d'échantillons spécifiques, il est important que les candidats correspondent étroitement à nos exigences de mesure et maintiennent des mesures qui demeurent cohérentes au fil du temps.

Vous devriez :

- Être basé dans la région de Zurich et capable d'assister à des séances en personne - Être flexible en ce qui concerne la programmation des rendez-vous et la durée des séances - Être disponible pour assister à des séances de préparation au moins deux jours de semaine par semaine, selon les besoins - Maintenir un chiffre cohérent qui s'harmonise avec nos exigences de modèle d'ajustement - Être à l'aise de participer aux activités de test axées sur les mouvements

Comment faire une demande

Veuillez soumettre vos mesures selon les instructions fournies dans le formulaire de demande. Utilisez une mesure par ruban et enregistrez toutes les mesures en centimètres.

Formulaire de demande: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/f/1FAIpQLSfYxhY8kQxlua6qW0MCpxhyG2eNTbRwW9Ut5_6LfVneGlseyA/viewform?usp=publich-editor

Renseignements supplémentaires

En tant que modèle d'ajustement, vous pouvez être exposé à des produits et des développements confidentiels. Nous accordons donc une grande valeur au professionnalisme, à la discrétion et à la confiance.

Veuillez noter qu'en raison des exigences spécifiques de mesure de ce rôle, seuls les candidats qui satisfont aux critères du modèle de conformité seront contactés.

Ce que nous offrons

Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils de développement holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère solidaire et axée sur l'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par un but.

Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.
